_about: Public-domain François-René de Chateaubriand (1768-1848) in English, religious works only, for the Word Hoard: The Genius of Christianity, tr. Charles I. White (Baltimore and Philadelphia, 1856), and The Martyrs; or, the Triumph of the Christian Religion (3 vols, New York, 1812), from Internet Archive scans. His Memoirs are on lane C's teixeira-de-mattos shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

chateaubriand-genius-christianity: The Genius of Christianity; or, the Spirit and Beauty of the Christian Religion, tr. Charles I. White (Philadelphia: Lippincott; Baltimore: John Murphy, 1856)
chateaubriand-martyrs-1: The Martyrs; or, the Triumph of the Christian Religion, vol. I (New-York: Whiting and Watson, 1812)

chateaubriand-martyrs-3: The Martyrs; or, the Triumph of the Christian Religion, vol. III (New-York: Whiting and Watson, 1812)
